# Perplexity changelog + API reference — captured 2026-08-09
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog , https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference

Changelog: **no August 2026 entries.** Newest remains the July 2026 batch, all reported 2026-08-07:
Gateway API (OpenAI Chat Completions + Anthropic Messages wire compatibility, health-based routing);
hosted remote MCP server at https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp; MCP Server 1.0 moving from Sonar models
to Agent API presets; Agent API model adds (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Gemini 3.6 Flash
and 3.5 Lite, Grok 4.5, Kimi K3); inline and source-typed citations; Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite retired.

API reference: endpoint surface IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 capture. POST /v1/agent (plus
GET /v1/responses/{id} for background polling); web / finance / people search; fetch_url; sandbox
code execution; function calling; remote MCP tool discovery; skills (built-in Office generation plus
inline custom skills); reasoning effort minimal..max; model fallback chains up to 5; JSON-schema
structured output; per-operation cost tracking.

Updated: 2026-08-09 — no change.
